headline: Refining margins spike as Iran conflict disrupts crude and fuel supply
overview: Diesel and gasoline cracks remain elevated (ULSD crack near $97/bbl, RBOB crack near $48.5/bbl) as Iran-related tensions and Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries tighten global product supply. Nymex ULSD and RBOB both posted sharp weekly gains, while EPA's move to extend the RFS compliance deadline and ongoing SAF/renewable diesel developments add a policy dimension to an already supply-constrained market.

stories.title: Global refining disruptions turn the oil shock into a fuel supply crisis
stories.summary: Pressure in global energy markets is shifting from crude toward refining capacity, with record margins, disrupted capacity and tighter exports creating what's being called a fuel supply crisis.

stories.title: Front Month Nymex ULSD Rose 4.95% This Week to Settle at $4.4948 — Data Talk
stories.summary: Front-month Nymex ULSD for September delivery rose 4.95% this week to settle at $4.4948/gal, its largest two-week gain since July 2026.

stories.title: Nymex Overview: Crude and Product Prices End the Day, Week Higher — OPIS
stories.summary: Crude and refined products ended the day and week higher on Nymex; September RBOB climbed 8.5cts to $3.3479/gal, up 5.1% for the week.

stories.title: “Get Long And Buckle Up.” Jeff Currie Explains How To Play The “The Most Asymmetric Trade In Modern Financial History.”
stories.summary: Former Goldman commodities chief Jeff Currie, now at Carlyle, told clients to 'get long and buckle up' for what he calls the most asymmetric trade in modern financial history amid rising volatility.

stories.title: Farmers Face Higher Fuel Costs as Diesel Supplies Tighten
stories.summary: Diesel supplies are tightening ahead of a September 1 EPA rule allowing higher Reid vapor pressure gasoline, raising fuel costs for farmers.

stories.title: U.S. EPA to Extend Renewable Fuel Standard Compliance Deadline for Refiners
stories.summary: EPA plans to extend a September 1 deadline requiring refiners to demonstrate compliance with the nation's biofuel blending (RFS) laws.

stories.title: EPA extends deadline for refiners to comply with renewable fuel standard
stories.summary: EPA published a notice extending the deadline for oil refiners to comply with the Renewable Fuel Standard.

stories.title: Court Upholds Trump Admin Order to Restart SYU
stories.summary: A court upheld the Trump administration's order to restart the Santa Ynez Unit (SYU), which the DOJ called a win for domestic energy production.

stories.title: XCF Global ships 55,000 gallons of renewable diesel daily
stories.summary: XCF Global reports shipping 55,000 gallons of renewable diesel daily, establishing a baseline output as proof of physical production.

stories.title: Vitol Bunkers, Olam Agri complete world’s 1st coprocessed VLSFO biobunkering operation
stories.summary: Vitol Bunkers and Olam Agri completed the world's first coprocessed VLSFO biobunkering operation in Singapore, using cashew-nut shell liquid in a waste-to-energy approach.

stories.title: Ukrainian Drone Attack Hits Lukoil Refinery Deep in Russia
stories.summary: Ukrainian drones struck Lukoil's Perm refinery over 1,600 km from the Russia-Ukraine border, per Zelenskyy.

stories.title: Lukoil’s Perm refinery struck 1,530 km from Ukraine’s northern border, Kyiv confirms
stories.summary: Kyiv confirmed a strike on Lukoil's Perm refinery 1,530 km from Ukraine's northern border, part of an overnight wave that also hit a military airfield.

stories.title: Various Tankers Shuttle Saudi Oil North to Evade Houthis
stories.summary: Shipowners are rerouting Saudi crude tankers via the northern Red Sea route to avoid Houthi attacks near the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint.

stories.title: IndyCar switching to fully renewable fuel for 2027
stories.summary: IndyCar and Shell will introduce an updated 100% renewable race fuel for 2027, shifting feedstock sourcing domestically to the US from mostly international sources.
